column2: (b) In the event of a vacancy occurring due to the death,
resignation,  incapacity  or  removal  from  office  of  an  office
bearer,  the  Board  shall  having  regard  to  the  rules  of  the
Corporation, elect or appoint a person to fill such vacancy.
(c) The person elected or appointed under paragraph (b)
shall hold office only for the unexpired portion of the term of
office of the member whom he succeeds.
